mentions.name: Agentic startup process scaling software
mentions.description: This software packages the process of running a one-person startup with agentic systems so it can be scaled, and may be turned into a standalone product.
mentions.source_excerpt:
the whole process has led me to write a lot of software around my own process so that I can scale it.

Might turn that into a product itself.
